entry_point: Separate post-localization analysis using the persisted source/retained-block identities; no mutation of upstream classification.
backend_policy: Use the configured local generative backend, currently gemma3:4b by project default. Do not silently switch to installed 12b. A future separately approved preparation must pin the actual configured model digest, API/options/tokenizer context budgets before inference. No health-check generation, model acquisition or comparison now.
context_algorithm: Verify source snapshot, normalization version, block identity and provenance segments; fail closed on incompatible revisions.
Build conservative canonical anchor hull from source units contributing to the center block. Separately prove the exact center-content mapping; the hull alone is not semantic ownership.

Nominal context is the canonical hull of source units overlapping [center.start_seconds-120, center.end_seconds+120], including the whole anchor hull. This is bounded neighborhood construction, not a new transcript segmentation.
If anchor hull exceeds 6000 or exact source/center mapping cannot be established, defer. Never split a required anchor to obtain eligibility.

Let B=6000-anchor_hull_length. Allocate min(available_left,floor(B/2)) left characters; allocate min(available_right,B-left) right; give any remaining budget to unused left. Cap at nominal context. Trim optional excerpt edges inward to whitespace where possible without crossing anchor bounds. Preserve exact codepoint offsets and record cuts.

Mark earlier/later source, budget clipping and normalization-unit boundary cuts. Do not assert this is complete context. A missing remote link remains a nomination/source-review deferral; no model-driven expansion or second search.
